'''Huro''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="LotJ9">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> in the [[Huro system]] within the [[Ciutric sector/Legends|Ciutric sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> [[Trever Flume]] stopped at an exclusive [[Florist/Legends|florist]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] who sold exotic blooms and bought a small [[Plant/Legends|plant]] with vibrant [[Color/Legends|yellow]] leaves native to the planet Huro. It was the cheapest option they had.<ref name="LotJ9" />
